settings.schoolName: IDEAL GLOBAL ISLAMIC ENGLISH MEDIUM SCHOOL, KAMALAPURAM
settings.tagline: Shaping Bright Minds. Building Strong Values.
settings.heroDescription: Welcome to Ideal Global Islamic English Medium School, Kamalapuram — where quality English-medium education, Islamic values, discipline, creativity, and character development come together.
settings.address: Opposite Post Office, R.S. Road, Kamalapuram – 516289, Andhra Pradesh, India.
settings.announcement: Admissions Open for Academic Year 2026–2027 from Nursery to Class X! Call +91 9963377320 or apply online today.
settings.principalMessage: At Ideal Global Islamic English Medium School, we believe every child is blessed with a unique intellect and pure spirit. Our pedagogical journey is crafted to balance contemporary English-medium academics with timeless Islamic ethics, nurturing learners who think critically, behave respectfully, and excel with confidence.
settings.schoolHistory: Founded with a sacred vision to provide children of Kamalapuram and surrounding areas with exemplary English-medium schooling rooted in Islamic morals, discipline, and modern technological readiness.

notices.title: Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026–2027
notices.description: Enrolment forms for Nursery, LKG, UKG, and Classes I through X are now available. Parents can submit their enquiry online through this portal or visit the school office during working hours.

notices.title: Term Assessment & Parent-Teacher Interaction Schedule
notices.description: The upcoming continuous evaluation tests for Classes I to X will commence as per the published calendar. Detailed subject schedules and parent-teacher meeting slots will be shared via student diaries.

notices.title: Annual Seerat-un-Nabi & Moral Values Elocution Programme
notices.description: Students from Primary to Secondary sections participated with great enthusiasm in speech, calligraphy, and Quranic recitation presentations highlighting ethical character and compassion.

notices.title: Science & Digital Literacy Exhibition 2026
notices.description: Our computer lab and science classrooms hosted dynamic student model demonstrations, practical experiments, and foundational coding displays for visiting parents.

notices.title: School Uniform and Punctuality Guidelines
notices.description: All parents are requested to ensure students arrive promptly by 8:30 AM in clean, compliant school attire. Regularity and discipline are fundamental to our learning ethos.

academics.summary: Playful, joyful foundational learning that builds cognitive curiosity, early phonics, bilingual conversational ease, fine motor skills, and moral gentleness.
focus: Interactive activity-based learning without heavy homework pressure
Habits of hygiene, polite manners, and sharing
Foundational Arabic phonetics (Noorani Qaida basics) alongside English alphabets

academics.summary: Solidifying numeracy, literacy, linguistic versatility, hands-on scientific observation, computer exposure, and daily practice of Islamic etiquette.
focus: Fluency in spoken and written English with vocabulary enrichment
Conceptual math foundations through problem-solving and mental drills
Basic computer education starting early with hands-on practice
Character building, truthful conduct, and daily Duas and etiquettes

academics.summary: Encouraging structured inquiry, critical thinking, experimental scientific investigation, technological fluency, and deep ethical conviction.
focus: Inquiry-driven science with classroom experiments and project models
Computer applications, logic formulation, and digital citizenship
Public speaking, elocution, essay writing, and regional debate participation
Adolescent character mentoring grounded in respectful Islamic brotherhood

academics.summary: Rigorous academic preparation, conceptual mastery across core disciplines, targeted exam readiness, leadership skills, and righteous civic responsibility.
focus: Systematic syllabus coverage with regular unit tests and remedial support
Dedicated revision sessions and past question paper analyses
Career and higher education counselling for post-matriculation pathways
Nurturing confident, grounded individuals who shine in both faith and academics

facilities.name: Well-Ventilated Classrooms
facilities.description: Spacious, airy classrooms designed with ergonomic wooden benches, ample natural window light, blackboard fixtures, and an environment conducive to focused study.

facilities.name: Dedicated Computer Laboratory
facilities.description: Modern computer education workstations where students learn foundational digital literacy, typing, office tools, and introductory logical problem solving.

facilities.name: School Library & Reading Resource
facilities.description: Curated collection of age-appropriate English literature, reference books, encyclopedias, bilingual dictionaries, and inspirational moral literature.

facilities.name: Islamic & Moral Education Wing
facilities.description: Structured curriculum encompassing Noorani Qaida, Tajweed fundamentals, Islamic etiquette (Adaab), daily supplications (Duas), and character-building stories of the Prophets.
facilities.highlight: Integrating faith, ethics, and daily conduct

facilities.name: Sports & Physical Fitness Activities
facilities.description: Designated play areas for physical education drills, badminton, volleyball, athletics, and traditional games that instill sportsmanship, fitness, and teamwork.

facilities.name: Safe, Disciplined & Supportive Campus
facilities.description: Strict code of conduct, vigilant supervision, hygienic drinking water facilities, separate student amenities, and respectful teacher-student communication.

gallery.title: Interactive Mathematics & Science Classroom Session
gallery.description: Students actively engaged in geometry and formula derivations with teacher explanation.

gallery.title: Hands-on Practical Training in Computer Laboratory
gallery.description: Students developing essential digital keyboarding and software literacy under guidance.

gallery.title: Guided Reading Hour at the School Library
gallery.description: Primary pupils exploring science encyclopedias and moral storytelling books.

gallery.title: School Campus & Morning Assembly Forecourt
gallery.description: Clean, peaceful school grounds ready for daily morning prayer and national anthem.
